verdict.rationale: Drata explicitly claims AI agents can interact with it via natural language to automate compliance workflows, and an official MCP server is documented, which would enable natural-language operation through an AI agent intermediary. However, there's no first-party natural-language interface (chat/command bar) in the product itself, and probes show no llms.txt or accessible OpenAPI spec, suggesting limited AI-native tooling maturity. Missing for 10: evidence of a native NL command interface in the product UI, independent hands-on verification of the MCP server working, and accessible machine-readable API specs (openapi.json/llms.txt returned 404).
